about_the_game:
In A Song in Elyel Nalore, you'll step into the shoes of a skilled protagonist who takes on a simple guild job that turns into a dangerous quest to uncover dark secrets.  This Metroidvania-style action adventure combines intense platforming, dynamic combat, and immersive world-building to create an unforgettable journey. 

Key Features:

  • Exploration & Discovery: Dive into a vast, beautifully crafted world where every corner holds hidden secrets.  Traverse ancient ruins, dense forests, and mystical caverns as you unlock new areas and discover powerful upgrades.

  • Dynamic Combat System: Master a fluid and fast-paced combat system, combining swordplay and mystic arts.  Use a wide range of abilities to take down terrifying enemies, solve puzzles, and face off against epic bosses.

  • Engaging Story: Unravel a gripping tale of mystery, betrayal, and the consequences of a broken world.  The world of Elyel Nalore is rich with lore, where the protagonist's actions will shape the future of this ancient land.

  • Challenging Platforming: With precision platforming mechanics, your agility will be tested as you leap across crumbling ruins, scale massive cliffs, and navigate treacherous landscapes.  Every jump and roll matters in your pursuit of victory.

  • Pixel Art Beauty: Immerse yourself in stunning pixel art that brings the world to life with atmospheric environments, beautifully animated characters, and a deep, haunting soundtrack. 

  • Character Progression: Enhance your abilities, unlock powerful new skills, and gain strength as you venture deeper into the unknown.

A Dark Fantasy World Awaits

 

The land of Elyel Nalore is a place where magic and mystery collide, where ancient gods are whispered about in the dark hours of the night.  Will you uncover the truth or will the darkness consume everything you hold dear?

A Song in Elyel Nalore offers a rich and deep Metroidvania experience that will keep you coming back for more.  With every new ability you gain, every area you unlock, and every enemy you defeat, you'll be drawn further into a world that needs saving—and a story that begs to be told.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo and 2.0GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo and 2.0GHz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Plays better with Xbox controller.

short_description: "A Song in Elyel Nalore" is a 2D Metroidvania adventure set in a world of swords and magic. Accept a dangerous guild mission that leads you into a deadly journey. Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets, and face tough challenges in this dark fantasy action RPG.
supported_languages: English, Russian, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
